samples.question: The picture shows a white rectangular plate with a solid black border, and exactly five straight black walls drawn inside it. A wall splits a room in two only if it runs the whole way across that room, meeting black ink at both of its ends. A wall that stops short of the far side and leaves a white gap at one or both ends splits nothing, however long it is. The rooms are the separate white areas inside the border: two spots lie in the same room when you can walk from one to the other without crossing any black ink. How many rooms is the plate divided into? Answer 3, 4, 5, or 6.
